request: When decoding a filename rule from configuration, accept only text views tied to the input buffer and reject heap-allocated text supplied by the decoder, so our adapter can enforce a zero-copy contract.

source.request: When decoding a filename rule from configuration, accept only text views tied to the input buffer and reject heap-allocated text supplied by the decoder, so our adapter can enforce a zero-copy contract.
source.settled: Glob deserialization accepts owned strings as well as borrowed strings.
source.why: Rejecting allocated text restores the inability to deserialize owned strings that the ticket fixed.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
